verdict.rationale: Anomaly detection is a fair question for an application monitoring platform like Sentry, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only documents alerts that fire when issues 'match pre-defined rules', plus Seer's AI root-causing and triage of issues. Neither is anomaly, outlier, or dynamic-threshold detection, so no evidence shows the product surfaces problems without hand-written thresholds.

support.subject: As an SRE, I can enable anomaly or outlier detection that surfaces problems without hand-written thresholds
